ionic_conductivity.method: impedance spectroscopy on the single crystal

source.title: Diffusion coefficient of lithium ions in garnet-type Li6.5La3Zr1.5Ta0.5O12 single crystal probed by 7Li pulsed field gradient-NMR spectroscopy

interpretation: The publication reports D_tracer below the conductivity-derived D_sigma and calls their ratio 0.4. The simulation stores the reciprocal D_collective/D_tracer, so 2.5 is the like-for-like transformed point. No experimental uncertainty is inferred.
